violet: Quick postmortem follow-up — recurring partial responses and timeouts on streaming. Need owners for runtime fix, observability, SDK audit, and customer notes. Suggest: @kevin runtime, @anya metrics, @tomas SDK, @lina comms. Anyone object?
kevin: I'll take runtime. First steps: instrument kv-cache paths, add non-blocking eviction, and make keepalive ping optional.
anya: I'll add a small dashboard: partial_response_rate, first_token_latency, handshake_timeouts. Propose alert: partial_response_rate > 0.4% for 10m.
lina: I'll coordinate customer updates once we know deployments affected. Share list of deployment ids.
violet: Timeline: repro within 24h, PR in 48h, canary 72h after merge. We'll gate 24h metrics on canary.
ops-bot: Scheduling canary: RD-runtime v1.22.5 -> canary-a at 2026-03-12T03:00Z.
kevin: Adding reconnect/backoff config and server ACK on first-partial; toggleable flags for canary. Opening RD-10150.
anya: Runbook draft: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-partials>. Will link alerts to pager if prod threshold breached.
violet: Action items recorded: RD-10150 (kevin), RD-10151 (anya), RD-10152 (tomas), RD-10153 (lina). Please post daily 1-line updates here.
